summary: Iteration 23 full E2E of Jolly Tur data enrichment + Şube Haritası + Excel export. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases PASS (overview headcount=52, headcount kpis, recruitment funnel Applied=122/Hired=12, learning total_hours>1000, engagement total_surveys=51 avg_engagement/enps, skills-map 18 unique skills + heatmap + gaps, internal-mobility department_needs no 500, career kpis with talent_pool/manager_count/succession_coverage, segments returns turizm depts Kadıköy/Alsancak + HRBPs Seda/Mert/Ayşe/Kerem, /api/jolly/harita returns 5 bolgeler + 12 subeler with lat/lng). Frontend: admin login OK, all 5 standard report pages load (Overview shows '52', Kadro shows '52', Recruitment/Skills-Map/Engagement render). JollyTur custom page has 7 tabs including new jt-tab-harita; Turkey map SVG renders with 5 colored regions + 12 branch markers + region/branch performance panels. Excel export buttons present on all 7 tabs (overview:3, hedef:4, yetkinlik:4, kalibrasyon:3, matris:1, karne:1, harita:1 = 17 total, all with data-testid excel-export-*).

minor.issue: Response does not expose top-level 'total_applications' or 'hired' keys as review spec expects; values are derivable from funnel[] stages (Applied=122, Hired=12). Consider surfacing them at top-level or under kpis for API consumers.

Business metrics (headcount, hires, leaves, turnover_rate, female_leaders, avg_age, avg_seniority) are nested under kpis{} rather than top-level; tests had to flatten. Ensure frontend reads the same nested path.

issues: Same as iter22: outer report wrapper filters (Tümü/Tüm Departmanlar/Tüm HRBP/2025) still shown above Jolly-specific Bölge/Şube/Rol filters — visually redundant.
Branch markers overlap slightly for close cities (e.g. İstanbul cluster) — labels stack over the map, consider offset labels or hover-only tooltips.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Surface 'total_applications' and 'hired' at top level of /api/dashboard/recruitment for API contract cleanliness (data currently only under funnel[]).
OPTIONAL: Consider consolidating standard report page filters with the Jolly-specific ones on the custom performance page.
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard response schema inconsistency: some endpoints put KPI numbers under top-level, others under 'kpis' — standardize.
JollyTurPage.jsx now has 7 tabs (was 6). File is likely >900 lines — should be split per tab file (still >700 line threshold).
harita endpoint good: returns bolgeler with iller[] and subeler with lat/lng — matches frontend react-simple-maps consumer.
Excel export buttons follow consistent data-testid pattern excel-export-JollyTur_* — good for automated testing.
seed_data_creation: None (uses existing jollytur enriched seed: 55 emps [51 active + 4 left], 200 recruitment, 192 training, 51 engagement, 6 exit, 20 onboarding, 631 pulse).
